meta.title: A leakage-audited, uncertainty-calibrated pipeline for residential energy prediction: national-scale evidence from 18,496 U.S. households with climate-regime generalisation and simulation-validated retrofit bounds
highlights_bullets: Nine-test leakage audit per run; 16-day re-execution reproduces metrics
Conformal intervals from an untouched split: 90.2% coverage at 90%
Honest RECS 2020 ceiling: test R2 0.64 unweighted, 0.76 log out-of-fold
LOGO mean R2 0.70; sim-to-survey transfer adds nothing measurable
Naive retrofit estimate flips sign; matched-cell correction restores it
